description: List the browser tabs Qiksy can read, including which are ISOLATED multi-login sessions (isolatedSession = the login name). Use a tab's tabId with the other tools to read that specific login. With two browsers or Chrome profiles connected at once, every tab also carries `browser` (1 = the one connected first) and the reply says `browsers`; pass the tabId and the call goes to the browser that holds that tab, while a call with no tabId goes to browser 1.
name: qa_tabs
title: QA tabs
